title: Adaptive acceptance harness for batch/cache recommendations with human-in-the-loop audit
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Ship an adaptive acceptance harness that evaluates, approves, and safely applies batching/caching configuration recommendations from the cost optimizer while guaranteeing no meaningful quality regressions for customer traffic. This ticket implements the test orchestration, decision logic, and human-in-the-loop audit UI hooks for final approvals.

Scope:
- Ingest recommended config candidates (microbatch size, prefix caching rules, TTL heuristics) from the optimizer.
- Run quick micro-evals against stratified query buckets (anchor/golden prompts, long-form, short interactive, high-entropy queries).
- Compute behavioral fingerprint deltas (response shape, token distributions, auto-eval metrics) and run statistical acceptance tests.
- If automated criteria pass, run a progressive canary apply with shadow traffic and sampling.
- Provide a compact human audit summary with examples, failure modes, and action buttons: Approve / Request Human QA / Rollback.

We emphasize short feedback loops: candidate -> evals (10-30m) -> canary -> 1h shadow -> apply or rollback. Automation must be conservative by default and tunable per-customer or per-route.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Automated acceptance must flag regression if any of the three anchor sets show >2% absolute drop in pass-rate or any model-quality metric (ROUGE-L, BLEU-ish conversational score) degrades by >3%.
2) Behavioral fingerprint distance (cosine over embedding of metadata+response) threshold validated on historical config changes must not exceed configured limit (default 0.08).
3) Canary must run for at least 1 hour or 10k tokens before auto-apply.
4) Human audit view must surface 25 representative examples (passed/failed) and allow a reviewer to approve or escalate.
5) Full rollback path executed without customer-visible error and with metric recovery within SLA windows.
rollout_plan:
1) Local simulated runner using replay corpus (dev cluster) -> 2) Shadow canary on internal test tenants (5%) for 1 hour -> 3) External canary on low-risk routes (1%) for 2 hours -> 4) Gradual ramp using exponential backoff to target share with monitoring gates.
Gating checks at each stage: error-rate, latency p95, anchor-pass delta, behavioral fingerprint delta. Failure stops rollout and triggers automatic rollback and Slack alert to #runtime-oncall.
rollback_plan:
- Immediate stop of new config in router and revert to previous pinned configuration.
- Run automated recovery test: replay 1k recent requests against reverted config and validate anchors return to baseline.
- If automated rollback fails, open P0 incident with runbook: capture process dump, route traffic away from affected pool, notify affected customers.
- Postmortem required for any rollback that affects customer-visible quality or latency beyond 15 minutes.
qa_plan:
- Unit tests for evaluation harness (statistical tests, fingerprint computation).
- Integration tests: apply a synthetic config that intentionally degrades an anchor to ensure harness rejects it.
- End-to-end smoke with replay corpus and internal canary tenants.
- Human QA session: 2 cross-functional reviewers (SRE + PM) validate human-audit UI workflow and edge-case samples.
- Performance load test: ensure harness orchestration adds <5% overhead to config apply path.
evaluation_suite_spec:
- Golden anchor sets: three disjoint corpora (anchor_short.json, anchor_long.json, anchor_edgecases.json).
- Metrics: anchor pass/fail, ROUGE-L on referenceable tasks, perplexity drift, embedding cosine distance, and custom conversational coherence score (0-5) from human labels.
- Statistical tests: paired permutation test for anchor pass, Mann-Whitney U for metric shifts, and bootstrap CI on mean deltas.
- Acceptance thresholds are configurable per route; defaults live in cost-optimizer config: {anchor_pass_drop:0.02, metric_rel_drop:0.03, fingerprint_cosine:0.08}.
notes: Prefer conservative defaults for first 6 weeks and expose tuning knobs in console (per-route override).
Coordinate with Console team to add human-audit approval modal and audit logs (audit log schema in Console PR).
This harness reuses portions of ENG-42877 fingerprinting pipeline and ENG-31209 shadow canary runner.
